notes.title: Awesome news! We're coming to Insomnia 64! :)
Misc Fixes
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, a little update just went live:
[list]
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue with Gun Timeout not activating while playing the game one Xbox One / Xbox 360 controller
[*] Stopped Vicious Red Hole from spawning on final waves of level 2 and level 4 (prevents potential framerate drop caused by win / defeat screen clashing)
[/list]
Cheers

notes.title: Space Toads Mayhem price reveal!
notes.content:
Excited to announce that Space Toads Mayhem will have a price of $3.99 USD on Steam (£2.89 for those in Britain) - and there will be a rather nice launch discount of 15% :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32854806/1dbe2abe11d57c98e412a7f4b0017f55a6ca034d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Whooohoo!
notes.content:
Finally... the time has come.. to announce.. the release date! 

20th November 2018 is THE day - mark this in your calendars, and get ready to blast some vicious alien creatures out of The Galaxy

Also, don't forget to check out our new launch trailer and succulent new screenshots

Thanks everyone for the continued support, what a journey it has been up until this point !:)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32854806/1ab73dfbc77db42e8508e33523d7baf3a8cebea9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: We're coming to PLAY Expo Blackpool !:)
notes.content:
Come and play the FINAL version of the game before the release at PLAY EXPO Blackpool :)

It's a 2 day event happening Saturday 27th / Sunday 28th October at the Norcalympia Exhibition Centre in Blackpool - tons of retrogaming goodness guaranteed

See you there!
